# Unity AI Visual Reskin

> AI-first visual intelligence, local Visual RAG, semantic Theme Packs and
> GUID-safe reskin transactions for Unity.

Canonical repository:
https://github.com/orange91pku/unity-ai-visual-reskin

Related structural context engine:
https://github.com/orange91pku/unity-ai-project-brain

## Invariants

- proposals never authorize mutation;
- `.meta` and Unity GUID remain unchanged during raster replacement;
- candidates and databases stay outside Unity Assets;
- default proposals exclude Editor and zero-reference images;
- apply requires an exact approval ID;
- failure after backup rolls back exactly;
- technical and visual verdicts are separate.
